context: A career coach discusses private-school vs public goals with a uni student
purpose: Teach: ボード/部下/発注/切り替え/エラー/同期/私立/志向

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: まずホワイトボードに、君の進路の選択肢を書き出してみようか。
lines.en: First, let's write out your career options on the whiteboard.
lines.style: Warm coaching tone, gentle pacing, inviting the student to think visually.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 正直、私立の中高一貫校で教えたいのか、公立志向で行くのか、まだ迷っています。
lines.en: Honestly, I'm torn between teaching at a private secondary school or going the public-school route.
lines.style: Hesitant, reflective university-student voice with a hint of self-doubt.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 迷うのは自然なこと。気持ちの切り替えも大事だから、一度深呼吸してみて。
lines.en: It's natural to hesitate. Switching your mindset matters too, so take a deep breath.
lines.style: Soothing mentor cadence, lowering tension before the next question.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 実は先日、教育実習の同期と話したら、みんな教材の発注や成績入力のエラーで疲れ切ってて…。
lines.en: Actually, when I talked with my teaching-practice peers the other day, they were all worn out from textbook orders and grade-entry errors.
lines.style: Confiding, slightly anxious, sharing real-world worries from recent experience.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: なるほど。最初の数年は直属の部下のように先輩の指導を受けながら、そういう細かい仕事に慣れていくんだよ。
lines.en: I see. For the first few years, you'll follow senior teachers like a direct report and gradually get used to those small tasks.
lines.style: Informative, grounded, drawing on insider knowledge of school workplaces.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 私立だと校風が強いって聞きますが、本当にやりがいはあるんでしょうか?
lines.en: I've heard private schools have strong identities — is the work really rewarding there?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity tinged with skepticism, leaning forward in the conversation.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 学校によるね。進学実績を重視する私立もあれば、自由を重んじる公立もある。両方見学してから決めても遅くないよ。
lines.en: It depends on the school. Some privates focus on university placement; some publics value freedom. Visit both before deciding.
lines.style: Balanced, encouraging exploration, treating the student as a capable adult.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。ボードを見ながら整理したら、少し頭がクリアになりました。
lines.en: Thank you. Looking at the board and organizing it has cleared my head a bit.
lines.style: Grateful, lighter tone, showing visible relief and renewed focus.
